AFORMAS.Vazio: No forms yet. Add the first one.
AFORMAS.DicaTamanho: Blank width, height and scale stay the same as the original form.

Aviso.SemPermissao: You do not own this token.
Aviso.ImagemNaoCarrega: The image of form "{forma}" failed to load: {img}
Aviso.SemImagem: Form "{forma}" has no image and was not saved.

Config.ShiftCliqueDica: Hold Shift and click one of your tokens to move to the next form (after the last one, back to the original). Only applies to tokens with forms; on others Shift still adds to the selection.
Config.IdiomaDica: Language used by this module's windows, messages and settings. "Follow Foundry" uses the same language as Foundry. Reloads the page.
Config.TransicaoDica: Effect used when the token changes form.
Config.JogadorConfiguraDica: If off, players can only switch between forms created by the GM.

Tecla.ProximaDica: Moves the selected tokens to their next form.
